notes: No term is zero: for every n an n-digit admissible multiple exists (A084013 and A084015 conjectures are the same existence statement). Construction: 10-free part n'=g m; g=1: U_r(10^(L-r)+1) with r=3^k phi(m') <= m and 9m | 10^r-1 (LTE); g>1: low block G 9^(R-e) (9-G) mirrored, R=e phi(m), both halves multiples of 10^R-1. Reading: for n=10^s n', N=10^s u with u a palindrome (reproduces a(10)). Lean: A084013_main. Outside Lean: none.

prior_art.note: Fixed-length palindromic multiples not found in the literature; Harminc-Sotak give existence without length control.
